dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Giblets?

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: There's nothing to worry about, everything's washed thoroughly before I use it.

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: I have some customers who never used to go near any kind of animal innards, but after they'd tried it here they simply fell in love with it!

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: Go on, have a taste! Free of charge. If you like it, please come back and buy some more!

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: There's nothing better than piping hot Zhongyuan Chop Suey!

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: There's only one fool who would ever say otherwise!

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: I'd like to buy a snack.

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: Sure thing, we've got hot chop suey fresh from the oven!

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: Chop suey...?

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: I know, I know, the name sounds a little odd.

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: But Zhongyuan Chop Suey is a local specialty here in Chihu Rock.

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: It all starts with rinsed giblets that are chopped into mince meat. Then you add some Tiger Fish gelatin along with some starch and other ingredients, and roll it into meatballs.

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: After a quick deep fry, they're ready to be enjoyed. Not a hint of fish in that wonderful aroma!

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: But it sure is troublesome having to explain the name to every outlander that shows up to eat here, whew!

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: Who's the fool that disagrees?

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: Why, that manager of the warehouse, Gou San'er. Who else!?

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: After working all morning to prepare the food, I saw him looking after the warehouse all by himself. He looked quite tired, so I offered him some...

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: Once he was finished, I asked him if he liked it. He said that he would have preferred something saltier and spicier!

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: Some nerve he has talking like that! And to think that I was kind enough to offer him some!

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: You see? I get all worked up just thinking about it. I'll be sure teach him a thing or two about good cooking!

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Su Er'niang
dialogues.text: Bring some of your friends along next time and I might even give you a discount!
